newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Wing Tai to raise funds from share issue.
newsitem.headline: Wing Tai to raise funds from share issue.

text.p: Property developer Wing Tai Holdings said in a statement on Friday it is proposing to raise up to US$200 million through an issue of redeemable convertible cumulative preference shares (RCCPS) of US$1 each.

The company, which put in aggressive top bids for prime residential sites in Singapore on Wednesday, said it would raise US$150 million from the RCCPS issue, with the option of increasing the issue up to US$200 million. The issue price of each RCCPS would be about US$1,000.
The proceeds would be used to repay existing loans, for general working capital and for future property developments and investments.
